full_prompt_en: A square mid-century pulp-cover-style oil painting shows a dark-haired woman seated alone at a small restaurant table. She occupies the left and center of the frame, turned slightly toward the viewer with forearms resting across a cream tablecloth. Her short black curls frame a pale face with sharply lit cheekbones, dark eyes, and red lips. A deep green sleeveless dress forms a nearly black mass around her torso and lap. Near her right hand, a shallow stemmed glass holds pale golden wine; a dark bottle stands farther back at the right edge of the table. The surrounding room is barely described: a brown-black wall, a hint of chair back, and thick shadows leave the table and face as the only clear planes. A warm side light strikes her forehead, shoulders, forearms, and the cloth, while half the face and dress fall into dense reddish shadow. The glass catches a tiny bright rim and stem highlight. Brushwork is visible but controlled, with broad smeared dark passages behind the figure and smaller blended strokes modeling skin and fabric. The palette stays within deep burgundy, umber, dark green, cream, and limited amber; the red mouth provides a compact accent. Her direct, reserved expression creates narrative tension without any overt action. There is no writing or graphic title inside the image. The whole painting feels like a quiet moment in a noir story, its intimacy shaped by concentrated light, empty dark space, and a few suggestive table objects.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形二十世纪中叶通俗小说封面感油画描绘一名黑发女子独坐在小餐桌旁。她占据画面左侧与中央，略转向观者，前臂搭在奶油色桌布上。短而卷的黑发围住淡色面孔，颧骨被鲜明照亮，眼睛深暗，嘴唇红艳。深绿无袖裙在躯干和膝上形成近黑大块。右手附近，一只浅口高脚杯盛着淡金色葡萄酒；一只深色酒瓶立在桌子更右后方。周围房间只略有描述：棕黑墙面、椅背暗示和厚重阴影，让桌面与脸成为仅有的清晰平面。暖侧光打在额头、肩、前臂与桌布上，半边脸和衣裙则落进浓密红棕阴影。酒杯边缘与杯脚接住微小亮光。笔触可见但受控，人物后方是宽而涂抹的深色段落，皮肤和布料则由较细、融合的笔触塑形。调色限于深酒红、赭棕、深绿、奶油白和少量琥珀色；红唇给出紧凑点色。她直接而克制的表情无需明显动作便形成叙事张力。图像内没有文字或封面标题。整幅画像黑色电影故事中的安静片刻，亲密感由集中光线、深暗空处和少量带暗示性的桌上物构成。
style_prompt_en: Mid-century pulp-style oil painting uses concentrated warm side light to pull a small set of forms out of extensive brown-black negative space. Broad dark brush passages stay comparatively rough, while lit surfaces receive smoother modeled strokes and sharp accents. Deep burgundy, umber, green-black, cream, and sparse amber create a restrained dramatic palette; a tiny saturated red note can focus attention. A pale horizontal plane near the lower edge balances a darker upright mass and a few compact reflective highlights. Half-lit contours and dense shadows leave room for an implied story. The finish is visibly painted rather than photographic, with tactile transitions and a close, suspenseful atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 二十世纪中叶通俗封面感油画用集中的暖侧光从大片棕黑留白中拉出少量形体。宽阔深色笔触相对粗粝，受光表面则以更平滑的塑形笔痕和锐利点色处理。深酒红、赭棕、绿黑、奶油白和稀疏琥珀构成克制而戏剧化的调色；一点饱和红可集中注意力。靠近下缘的浅色水平平面平衡较暗的直立体块与几个紧凑反光点。半明半暗的轮廓和浓重阴影给未说出的故事留下空间。成品明显保留绘画性而非摄影感，过渡有触感，气氛贴近且悬疑。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman waiting beside a wine glass in a dim restaurant
theme_zh: 一名黑发女子在昏暗餐馆里坐在酒杯旁等待
name: James Avati
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
